info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Counterparty Risk Management API
info.description: The Counterparty Risk Management API is designed to facilitate the assessment and management of risks associated with counterparties in banking operations. This endpoint allows users to submit relevant data for new counterparties, enabling the identification and evaluation of potential financial risks. Financial institutions and risk management teams can leverage this API to enhance their decision-making processes and ensure compliance with regulatory standards. Use cases include onboarding new clients, assessing risk profiles, and performing ongoing risk evaluations.

post.summary: Create a new counterparty risk assessment.
post.description: This endpoint allows users to create a new assessment for counterparty risk. Provide the necessary details in the request body to evaluate the risks associated with a specific counterparty in your operations.
